sources.would_have_supported: the SGST half of an intra-State supply made in a State. The corpus therefore carries no SGST rate at all, and an intra-State supply in a State comes back UNCLEAR. Intra-State supplies in a Union Territory are computable, because UTGST is notified by the Central Government and 1/2017-Union Territory Tax (Rate) is a CBIC document.
